newsitem.title: USA: American Disposal files 3.5 mln shr offer.
newsitem.headline: American Disposal files 3.5 mln shr offer.

text.p: American Disposal Services Inc filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for an offering of 3.5 million shares.

The Burr Ridge, Ill., solid waste disposal company said in the filing that proceeds will be used to repay debt, to fund its acquisition of Liberty Disposal Inc, for possible future acquisitions, for working capital, and for general corporate purposes.
Underwriters Oppenheimer & Co Inc and Credit Suisse First Boston have an over-allotment option on an additional 525,000 shares, the company said.
